hints.title: Combinatorial Rank Counting
hints.text: The number of integers of length L with k set bits is comb(L - 1, k - 1).

hints.title: Digit by Digit Construction
hints.text: Determine the highest bit position where the set bits begin, then decide bit by bit whether to place a 1.

hints.title: Rank Deduction
hints.text: If the count of combinations with a 0 at the current bit is less than n, deduct that count and place a 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through all integers and testing popcount takes O(n * 2^k) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects combinatorial number system / lexicographical rank decoding.
